name: Bisi Bele Bath
subtitle: karnataka's one-pot rice and dal with vegetables, tamarind and hot ghee

image.alt: Bisi bele bath served hot with boondi and raita

ingredients.qty: small lime-sized ball, soaked in 1/2 cup hot water

ingredients.note: the closest catalogued stand-in for bisi bele bath powder. The cinnamon and cloves below make up the difference
balances the tamarind, do not skip
use compounded-free hing to keep this gluten-free
generous ghee is the point of the dish

prepNotes: Soak the tamarind in hot water for 15 minutes and strain out the extract before you start cooking.
Dry-roast the grated coconut in a pan until it smells nutty and turns light brown, then cool it.
Dice all the vegetables to the same size so they finish together.

steps.text: Pressure cook the toor dal with 2 cups water and the turmeric for 4 whistles, then mash it smooth.
steps.tip: It should pour off the spoon in a ribbon, with no whole lentils left.

steps.text: Separately cook the rice with 2.5 cups water until softer than you would want for plain rice.
steps.tip: Bisi bele bath wants overcooked rice. Firm grains never absorb the masala.

steps.text: Boil the carrot, beans, peas and onion in 1 cup salted water for 8 minutes, until a knife goes in with slight resistance.
Add the tamarind extract, sambar powder, cinnamon, clove powder, roasted coconut and salt to the vegetables.
Simmer this uncovered 8 minutes, until the raw tamarind edge disappears and the mixture darkens.
Fold in the mashed dal and the jaggery and cook 5 minutes more.
Stir in the cooked rice with the remaining water, a little at a time, until it flows like thick porridge.
steps.tip: It thickens fast as it stands, so keep it looser than looks right.

steps.text: Heat 3 tbsp ghee, pop the mustard seeds, fry the cashews to pale gold, then add the chilli, curry leaves and hing.
steps.tip: Cashews go from gold to burnt in about 15 seconds.

steps.text: Pour the tempering in, stir once, and serve very hot with the remaining ghee spooned over each plate.

storage: Keeps 2 days refrigerated. It sets solid when cold. Reheat with half a cup of hot water per portion, stirring until it flows again.

nutrition.method: Estimated from raw ingredients using USDA FoodData Central. Cooking losses are not modelled and added salt is excluded, so sodium is not given.
